comment: Does a very good job of explaining things if you are struggling. As everyone else says, he doesn't give A's but if you do your lab reports with proper notes and documentation he will grade fairly. He also sounds like Tim the Bear from The Cleveland Show.
Dr. Kanters is really nice and very helpful. Lab is difficult but he is forced not to give out A's. As long as you put in effort you will do fine. Sometimes he talks really fast so ask questions!

Thick accent. Hard grader BUT he is forced to not give A's. It's the way lab works here. Talk to him about it and you will understand. Grades are all equalized so it should not matter much. VERY willing to help- go see him!! Watch our for the group presentation-he criticizes like crazy. don't stress about lab-just put in effort.
Refuses to give above a B+ on lab reports for no reason. Hard, but will try to help you understand. He has a very thick accent and is extremely smart so he can be hard to understand at times

Worst lab I've ever had. He talks about subjects that may never be covered in lectures, and he grades very hard. Kanters is incredibly smart, but he's incapable of relating the material to anyone else. Good luck if you have to take him.
